text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Yasuda Kinen, I returned to the 
academy after Fuji Kiseki, who had gone 
back alone— and found a dark bay Umamusume 
hard at work in self-training.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah... haah. Alright, one more 
set...!

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Fuji-senpai's Trainer. 
What's up?
choice_data_list: Haven't you seen Fuji Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I think I saw her heading toward the 
outer perimeter." Spurred by those words, 
hours were spent searching outside.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah...
choice_data_list: Fuji Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! Sorry, sorry, I just really 
wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki tells me with a smile. At 
first glance, everything seems perfectly 
fine, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was also the sense of unease that 
Hishi Amazon felt. Something was 
definitely amiss.
choice_data_list: Are you worried about something?
Are you worried about something?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, did I make you worry? But hey, as you 
can see, I'm totally fine, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For better or worse, Fuji Kiseki is a 
consummate actor. She never lets negative 
emotions show on the surface.
choice_data_list: (But now that I think about it—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, sorry, sorry! I was just lost in 
thought!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There had been times when something felt 
off. Little by little, it had become 
impossible to completely hide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could the situation be far more serious 
than I thought? The moment that 
realization hits, a wave of intense regret 
washes over me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If only I had noticed sooner. If only I 
had been reliable enough for her to 
confide in."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to make a few adjustments. 
I'll be right back after a quick run, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't notice anything, and left her to 
fight all alone this entire time.
choice_data_list: Sorry for being so unreliable.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
But please, don't shoulder it all on your 
own anymore...

But please, don't shoulder it all alone 
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it, Trainer. Don't make 
that face, you did nothing wrong at all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I always wanted you to have fun, you 
know? So, that's why...—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“......Sorry. I'll explain everything. 
Shall we find a place to sit?”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Right now... everyone's expectations are 
just hopelessly terrifying to me."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's funny, really... considering how much 
I tried to get attention and be looked up 
to as an entertainer all this time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, it's not like I never felt 
any anxiety up until now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I was able to take it in a good, 
positive direction.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I had everything under control. Truly, I 
thought this was my own path. But, you 
see—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Classic year is over... well, 
the public got even more incredibly hyped 
than we expected, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Articles were written about me every day, 
magazines were sold out— of course, I was 
happy about that, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I was a little 
bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I wanted to do my best. To live up 
to expectations. And in the midst of that, 
a junior who looked up to me chose her own 
path.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—"Right now, I just changed the way an 
Umamusume lives her life." The moment that 
crossed my mind, it suddenly hit me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder... if I'm truly worthy of this 
much passion and adoration."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if that happens to be the way things 
are right now—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I worry that someday, somewhere down the 
line, a day might come when I let them 
down completely."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The instant that thought struck, the 
expectations that should have felt 
reassuring suddenly turned into pure, 
crushing pressure all at once.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, back then—)

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've decided on the path I must take. It's 
thanks to you that I was able to change, 
Fuji-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Fuji Kiseki was 
definitely lost for words back then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...After all that big talk about having my 
back, it kinda feels like, 'Wait, really?'

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even so, I can't help but wonder.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if deep down, I'm really not the 
kind of Umamusume everyone expects me to 
be."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so weak and pathetic, I make myself 
sick.
choice_data_list: That's not true.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ... You're so kind.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You said my running style looked strange 
today, right? Well, that was a huge hit, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Midway through running, before I knew it, 
I was subconsciously looking for excuses."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"She was no match for the grand stage of 
the Senior Year." "Just watching her take 
on the challenge gave us a dream."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If it doesn't turn out to be a brilliant 
run, what can I do so that no one blames 
them—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
On such a grand stage where everyone has 
high hopes, on a battlefield where 
everyone seeks victory... to only focus on 
things like that...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't get it out of my head.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for showing you such an 
unsightly side of me. I must have 
disappointed you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her tone remains indifferent, she 
can't quite hide the tremble in her voice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a palpable fear, something never 
once felt from her before.
choice_data_list: (She fought all the way to her limit.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the public's fervor was 
tremendous. Everyone, without exception, 
was looking forward to Fuji Kiseki's 
success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if Fuji Kiseki's own show and words 
sparked it, that tempestuous surge of 
passion must have been beyond 
expectations."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I'll be fine. I will see this challenge 
through. Everyone is waiting for me, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still... please just wait a little longer 
for now. I'll be back to my usual self in 
no time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki has lost her confidence right 
now, more than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's trying to push through on pure sense 
of responsibility, but judging by her 
state in the Yasuda Kinen, she will 
inevitably break down at this rate.
choice_data_list:
(More than anything, I don't want to make 
them suffer anymore.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki is a wonderful Umamusume. She 
has given dreams and hope to so many 
people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Those footprints should be all around us. 
If only I could show them to her—"
choice_data_list: Come with me for a second!
Come with me for a second!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! Trainer, what's got into you all 
of a sudden...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden memory of how "she" looked 
earlier flashes through my mind—and I rush 
toward the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dark bay Umamusume was still out on 
the track.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*! ...*gasp*, not yet! 
Daaaaahhh!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: She was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bursting with fighting spirit, she dashed 
up the slope at tremendous speed.
choice_data_list:
Thanks to you, I can look toward the 
future right now.

Thanks to you, I'm looking toward the 
future right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the past, she had grown rotten with her 
current situation. She resented her own 
aptitudes, and she resented her future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dark bay Umamusume's eyes, once dim 
with gloom, were now firmly looking ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki had changed things. By 
dedicating the entirety of her precious 
Classic year.
choice_data_list: You're a wonderful Umamusume.
You're a wonderful Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The dark bay Umamusume wasn't the only 
one who received something from Fuji 
Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where there is anticipation and 
excitement, a show worthy of them must 
follow.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what is that! What is that speed... 
is that Fuji Kiseki!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right! Wow, even though she's just 
running, she's so captivating I couldn't 
take my eyes off her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there is anxiety or doubt, give 
reassurance to dispel it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. ...A smile really does suit you 
best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Always, to anyone, I have given 
everything, risking my life to deliver it 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki isn't an entertainer just 
because she can run fast in races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Being charming or having a way with words 
doesn't automatically make someone an 
entertainer either."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If I want to put on the show everyone 
desires, just running and winning isn't 
enough."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—I'm going to push my limits just a little 
further!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to make people happier 
than anyone else could, that's what makes 
me an entertainer."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: …You truly are a wonderful Uma Musume…!
...You are a wonderful Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ... I wasn't alone after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All I could think about... was how I 
didn't want to disappoint you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I had intended for you to always watch my 
show from the prime seat known as my 
'Trainer.'"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“It seems... that was my own arrogance. 
You weren't in the stands at all.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She'd been watching over me from the wings 
of the stage the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's expression as she looked at 
me had regained just a tiny bit of its 
usual warmth.
choice_data_list:
...From now on, let's overcome everything 
together, the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I didn't realize it for so long. 
...Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't that the fundamental problem was 
solved, but—the two of them together could 
surely overcome it. Such a conviction was 
born.
